## Activity

During February 2022, North City Eye Clinic recorded 364 captures. This represents the activity submitted for review during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. Graders marked 4 captures as ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 1.1. These captures could not be used for grading. The ungradable result is reported separately from the grading outcome and reflects the proportion of captures for which an assessment could not be completed.

## Grading

A total of 94 results were graded referable. The median lag between capture and grading was 15. This measure provides the central indication of the time taken for results to progress through grading during February 2022. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures summarise the site’s operational performance for the reporting period.
